children.value: > Fact From Story The company may not intentionally suppress specific communities, but its moderation practices often disproportionately affect Palestinian users.
> > Fact From Story Meta’s black-and-white policies often preclude it from effectively moderating any nuanced topic, like content that discusses violence without condoning it.
